item.title: Honcho Pump Series Home Defense Shotguns – From Chiappa
item.description: Contrary to some popular belief, the shotgun is not dead. In fact, I believe it has seen a resurgence. Few guns have the real stopping power of a shotgun. Even more popular are shotguns configured with a birds-head-style grip, which exempts them from NFA regulations. One of the newest lines in this design is the Honcho Pump Series Home Defense Shotguns from Chiappa.
